report.verdict: A senior backend engineer with substantial payments experience and production results that fit money movement.
write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for senior backend work! At Lumen Ledger, you connect payments infrastructure to transaction volume, a zero-downtime migration and a substantial latency reduction. That gives a recruiter more than a list of technologies.

The balance API line is a great model: it names the problem, the change you made and the before-and-after result. Your headline fits the work, and your experience leads your education. The older Northgate role could say a little more about what maintaining the services involved.

For Cobalt Pay, keep the payouts and ledger work prominent, and bring the event-driven billing example forward. Add any direct on-call ownership, design review leadership or partnership work only if you did it. Your resume is unlikely to be the thing holding you back; competition for the role will matter too.

cards.line: Maintained the claims intake services in Java
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter knows which services you worked on, but not what maintaining them involved. One concrete change or problem you handled would give this earlier role more substance.
cards.example: Maintained the claims intake services in Java, including [a change you made or problem you handled]
cards.question: What change or problem did you handle in the claims intake services?

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 3
cards.line: Cut p99 latency on the balance API from 900 ms to 140 ms by moving reads to a Kafka-fed cache
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It gives a recruiter the technical choice and the measured result together, without making them guess what improved.

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 2
cards.line: Led the migration of the ledger from a single Postgres instance to a sharded cluster with zero downtime over six weekends
cards.cannot_tell: For a role above senior engineer, the technical decisions behind a migration and the teams affected can show how far your leadership reached.
cards.example: Led the migration of the ledger from a single Postgres instance to a sharded cluster with zero downtime over six weekends, making [a decision you made] for [teams affected]
cards.question: What decision did you make for the migration, and which teams did it affect?

fit.why: Your headline and current role center on backend payments services, ledger infrastructure and production reliability.
fit.level: senior, leads a ledger migration and mentors two mid-level engineers
fit.note: Your payouts service, ledger migration and latency work map closely to the money movement work. Bring your event-driven billing example forward and add relevant work your resume leaves out, if you did it.
